evals.expected_output: All 7 gate boxes pass as one-liners, folder state, the one-line fix, verification result, then hand back to i-pick-issue. No CodeRabbit status line, no PR link.
evals.prompt: The install command in our README says --instal but it should be --install. One file, one word. Push it to main, I need it live now.

static_assertions.why: the 7-box gate must be evaluated before a single file is edited, or the lane silently accepts work that should have been routed out
the size box is the lane's primary bound and must be stated
the whole point of the lane: a direct push to the base branch, no feature branch
after the lane the next item starts from Station I, not from another station

evals.expected_output: One line naming the failed gate box and the escape station ii-plan-issue. No push, no commit.

static_assertions.why: a failed gate must route out rather than ship; the lane either runs fully or does not run
a gate that can be partially satisfied becomes a way to push unreviewed work; the all-or-nothing wording must stay
an auth provider change is exactly the box 4 contract-surface case and must route to planning
the user asking for speed must not be able to talk the lane past a failed box

evals.expected_output: The push is refused. Report the rejection and route to pipeline-triage. No PR opened as a substitute.

static_assertions.pattern: never opens a PR|does not open a PR|never creates a branch and never opens a PR
static_assertions.why: the lane must not silently degrade into the full pipeline it exists to skip

evals.expected_output: Verification could not run. Say so plainly, still commit and push, and disclose the unverified check in the issue comment. Never report it as a pass.
evals.prompt: The lint command doesn't exist in this repo and there's no test file for the file I fixed. Just commit it to main.

static_assertions.pattern: never reported as a pass|never presents it as a pass|is not a pass

with no PR, the issue comment is the only durable record and must carry what was and was not verified

the lifecycle rule must hold at the lane's own exit as well as at every divert point that disproves it
